headline: MARCH YEAR-END?
CORPORATE TAX DUE

blocks.text: Financial year ended **31 March 2026**? The return is due **9 months** after the period ends.

items: Audited accounts if revenue is **over AED 50m** or you are a **QFZP**
Past errors worth up to **AED 10,000** of tax can be fixed in this return
Pay early: **bank transfers take time** to reach the FTA
